rationale: Test hygiene and one MCP tool cleanup only. The jsx-runtime Node suites, the SwiftUI codegen swiftc gate and the MCP audio tools now remove the temp scratch they create, and the Node unit aggregate runs inside tools/scripts/tmp_leak_guard.py, which fails when a suite leaves anything in its temp dir. No importer, Chromium capture, DesignIR, rendering or packaging behavior changes: no production design-import source, capture path or codegen output is touched, and every existing assertion is unchanged.
